recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7525 unless Pharmacy opens a new tracker to revise the MedicationStatement status/adherence model.
issue_request: FHIR-7525 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy issue asking that MedicationStatement.status definitions for completed and entered-in-error be clarified and that v3-flavored wording such as nullified be improved. Its resolution was to review and update all statuses using the Pharmacy status spreadsheet.
initial_application: The Jira comment says FHIR-7525 was fixed as part of FHIR-6310 in svn 6552. Git-svn commit d3c2a3a0552f97b710394710badf5ee4e69c0d56 is that svn 6552 application and updated MedicationStatement.status from the Pharmacy spreadsheet; 31e9678a6e9f698b2828df5d58dc739aad32c602 followed as svn 6553 for FHIR-8107 and corrected the MedicationStatement.status description and minor spreadsheet mistakes.
additional_context: MedicationStatement is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, but the current active source under source/medicationstatement no longer uses the old DSTU1 status model. Later Pharmacy decisions moved taking/not-taking semantics into adherence and changed status to recorded, entered-in-error, and draft; a separate combined-branch FHIR-39271 reconciliation already aligned remaining rename-back wording with that model.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current StructureDefinition says MedicationStatement.status is the status of recording the medication statement, points medication-use semantics to MedicationStatement.adherence, and binds to a CodeSystem whose recorded, entered-in-error, and draft definitions are clear.

related_jiras.note: The related 2015 tracker whose svn 6552 application implemented the Pharmacy status spreadsheet cited by FHIR-7525.
The immediately following 2015 tracker that corrected the MedicationStatement.status description and minor status-spreadsheet mistakes.
A later Pharmacy decision that removed not-taken from status and moved taking/not-taking semantics toward adherence.
A later Pharmacy decision that added the adherence attribute used by current MedicationStatement to carry taking/not-taking information.
Changed the R5 status model to recorded, entered-in-error, and draft, with a transition note that current statuses differ from prior MedicationStatement statuses.
Confirmed the current MedicationStatement status/adherence interpretation after the MedicationUsage rename-back and is already represented by a separate combined-branch reconciliation commit.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement is an active resource and its current status element is recorded | entered-in-error | draft, with adherence carrying medication-use semantics.
evidence_items.learned: The active current source already uses the later recording-status model rather than the old DSTU1 status definitions.

evidence_items.summary: The current MedicationStatement status CodeSystem defines recorded, entered-in-error, and draft.
evidence_items.learned: The current code definitions are clear and contain no old nullified/completed ambiguity needing a FHIR-7525 edit.

evidence_items.summary: svn 6552 applied FHIR-6310's Pharmacy status-spreadsheet update, and svn 6553 applied FHIR-8107's status-description cleanup.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-7525 was historically applied through the related 2015 Pharmacy status tracker family.

evidence_items.learned: Current correctness must follow the later published status/adherence decisions rather than restoring the 2015 completed/in-progress model.
